main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of next-3-bar excess return (vs coin mean 3-bar return) on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2.0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2.0; at least 300 nonzero-forecast grid cases

decided_by: the slope is positive with t >= 2.0 on at least 300 nonzero-forecast grid cases (confirm rule)
reading: the regression is OLS with an intercept on all grid cases with a valid next-3-bar return (zero forecasts included); the coin's mean 3-bar return is the mean of its grid returns over all windows; a shortfall of the plan's 300-case minimum is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow
